item.title: Get BOB on Your Alexa
item.description: If you own an Amazon smart speaker, like the Echo Plus or Echo Dot, you can listen to 107.1 Bob FM! First you need to enable our skill. Here are easy ways to do that:1. Say, “Alexa, enable 1 oh 7 1 Bob FM Redding”2. Visit the Skills section of your Alexa Smartphone App and search for 107.1 Bob FM After you have enabled the Skill, listen to our station just by saying “Alexa, open 1 oh 7 1 Bob FM” Sponsored by B&T satellite. Don’t call the 1-800 number call Doug and the Tooley Kids!
